guide.title: Before you search
guide.setupFirst: Set up the device in the SG app on your phone first. Homey does not add new devices to the network.
guide.closeApp: Close the SG app on all phones and tablets.
guide.near: Keep Homey close to one of the devices.
guide.password: The network password is 1234 unless you changed it in the SG app.
guide.passwordAccount: If Homey can't find the devices or they don't respond, log in with your SG account in the SG LEDDim settings.
guide.durationPill: The search usually takes less than a minute.
guide.fetchAgain: Added devices in the SG app since the last fetch? Tap "Fetch again" in the SG LEDDim settings.

sg3Guide.title: LEDDim Smart 3.0
sg3Guide.addFirst: Add new dimmers in the SG app first.
sg3Guide.loginFirst: Tap "Log in and fetch" in the SG LEDDim settings.
sg3Guide.fetchAgain: Tap "Fetch again" in the SG LEDDim settings.
sg3Guide.closeApp: Close the SG app on your phone.
sg3Guide.near: Keep Homey close to the dimmers. The search takes about 10 seconds.
sg3Guide.names: Want the names from the SG app? Tap "Fetch again" in the SG LEDDim settings first.

sg3.loginFirst: Log in with your SG account in the SG LEDDim settings first.

keepConnected.label: Keep SG LEDDim Gen1 connected
keepConnected.hint: Enable for faster response. If you have only one Gen1 device, the SG app on your phone cannot reach it while this setting is on.

laterKeepConnected.label: Keep SG LEDDim Gen2 to 4 connected (test)
laterKeepConnected.hint: Holds the link through the strongest device and asks one device every 4 seconds. For testing only: more Bluetooth traffic, and the SG app on your phone cannot reach that device while this is on.

sg3KeepConnected.label: Keep SG Smart 3.0 connected
sg3KeepConnected.hint: Enable for faster response. If you have only one 3.0 device, the SG app on your phone cannot reach it while this setting is on.

signal.title: Signal to Homey
signal.hint: Open a dimmer and check "Link". "Direct" means the dimmer has contact with Homey, and the others are reached through it. Weak signal? Move Homey closer to a dimmer.

otherDevice.title: Which SG devices are supported
otherDevice.rotary: First generation (Gen1, @NDxxxx) has been tested and works. Later generations, including TW, Master and 400 2-pole, are being tested.
otherDevice.pill: , including Micro, TW and Smart Pill ON-OFF: being tested.
otherDevice.din: , including DIN 1000 and TW: being tested.
otherDevice.plug: , Smart Socket and Smart DIN 3600: being tested.
otherDevice.thermostat: : the temperatures, the target temperature, on and off and the preset in Homey.
otherDevice.sg3: : LEDDim Smart 3.0 has been tested and works. LEDDim Smart 2-pole 3.0 is being tested. Both need you to log in with your SG account. Other 3.0 products are not supported yet.
otherDevice.other: Other SG devices, such as Push, Floor and Pill DALI, are not supported yet.
otherDevice.report: Something not working? Report it in the forum thread.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.hint: Enable only when the developer asks. Disable it before sending a diagnostic report.
